brief_en: Quiet 12-hour window for major frontier AI labs. No official model releases, product launches, research papers, or high-signal announcements from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, xAI or other tracked players. Minor executive commentary only.
brief_zh: 過去12小時各大前沿AI實驗室平靜。OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Meta AI、xAI等無官方模型發布、產品上線或重要研究公告，僅有少量高層評論。
